questions_for_advisor: The section records one rule that was learned rather than ruled, and it should be ratified or corrected: a command pinned to a specific HEAD cannot also have its IN_PROGRESS response committed first, because the commit moves HEAD off the pin. The section says the HEAD guard wins and the missing IN_PROGRESS commit is recorded as a departure. That is a process ruling the executor made under time pressure on 001 and has now written into the protocol. Confirm or replace it.

The response schema landed as the advisor ruled it — command_id, executed, head_before, head_after, results, deviations, questions_for_advisor — plus the status vocabulary. NO_ACTION was added to that vocabulary because 003 needed it and the ruled set did not contain it. Confirm.
